hooks.name: On architecture change
hooks.description: When the agent saves an approved architecture file, generate or update code, tests and trace links for the changed elements only, then run the drift check.

action.prompt:
An approved architecture file under architecture/ changed. Read the changed file and work out which elements are new or whose block changed; leave unchanged elements alone.

For each changed element:
1. Generate or update src/<element-id>.ts and test/<element-id>.test.ts.
2. Run `node mcp/update-trace.mjs <element-id>` to record it. Never hand-write or edit a trace.json row: the hash must come from that script or drift reporting breaks.

Then call the check_drift tool from the doppel-drift MCP server to verify your work, and fix anything it reports. Use the MCP tool, not the command-line script -- the tool is the supported interface and is already connected. Only if the tool is genuinely unavailable, fall back to `node mcp/check-drift.mjs` and say so explicitly.
